signal: Fixify raised a $25M Series A to scale its human-in-the-loop AI IT help desk and accelerate hiring and product development

email.body1:
Kaitlyn, saw Fixify raise its $25M Series A to scale the team and the AI help desk product.

After a raise, the bottleneck usually isn't intent data, it's the latency between a signal firing and a rep actually acting on it. Our AI SDR closes that gap, researching, writing, and following up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Fixify off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kaitlyn, quick follow-up for Fixify.

Most RevOps leaders I talk to are sitting on good signal but losing it to slow, manual follow-up and patchy CRM hygiene. The lift hides in the handoff, not the targeting.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, with every touch auto-logged to your CRM. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Kaitlyn, last bit of proof for Fixify.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Fixify's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kaitlyn, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Fixify either way.
